title: Cast concrete with formwork marks
purpose: Generate tileable PBR maps of cast concrete: cement mottling, bug holes, smooth, board-formed or panel formwork marks with tie holes, water stains, exposed aggregate and polished floors. Use for walls, floors and brutalist architecture.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python concrete_cast.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: formwork
parameters.meaning: Formwork imprint: 0 smooth, 1 horizontal boards, 2 plywood panels with tie holes.

parameters.name: panels
parameters.meaning: Boards (formwork 1) or panel rows and columns (formwork 2) across the tile.

parameters.name: mottling
parameters.meaning: Strength of the cloudy tone variation.

parameters.name: stains
parameters.meaning: Water stains running down from joints.

parameters.name: aggregate
parameters.meaning: Exposed aggregate: pebbles showing through the cement.

parameters.name: polish
parameters.meaning: Ground and polished finish (0 as cast, 1 polished floor).

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Smooth cast concrete with soft mottling and scattered bug holes.

presets.name: board_formed
presets.description: Board-formed concrete showing wood grain and board joints.

presets.name: tie_hole_panels
presets.description: Architectural panels with seams and tie holes.

presets.name: weathered
presets.description: Old dark concrete with heavy stains and exposed grit.

presets.name: polished_floor
presets.description: Ground and polished floor with exposed aggregate.

limits: Formwork marks are idealized: boards are horizontal and panels square, with four tie holes per panel. Stains always run toward the bottom of the tile. Aggregate stones are Voronoi cells. Occlusion is a blurred-height estimate.
technique_references: Fractional Brownian motion for cement mottling
Board grain imprint from stretched noise and per-board offsets
Downward exponential trail per column, swept twice for wrap-around
